about: The reference board: each view is one fixed picture of the game, shot with no GPU, beside its references and the operator's last word on it. node tools/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; docs/look.md is the loop; client/look.html is the same board in the page (each view's page names the page that draws it there).

views.name: Every material
views.what: every look (matte, plastic, ice, metal, hazard, glow, paint, checker, wood, rubber) on every shape, in daylight, with riders between them
views.take: materials read apart at a glance; the toy-box palette

views.name: A full stage
views.what: a full party stage of riders, the camera the game follows them with
views.take: every rider findable in a crowd; the stage reads before the players do

views.name: The horizon at sunset
views.what: the sea, the sky and the stage's edge at sunset
views.take: the backdrop's mood; the horizon line and the sun

views.name: Thin Ice from above
views.what: Thin Ice from above, the view when there is nobody to follow
views.take: a minigame's rules readable from the picture alone

views.name: The living room
views.what: the living room from the couch, in Grandma's theme, the TV showing a game
views.take: a warm room people want to sit in; the TV the brightest thing in it

views.name: The canyon floor
views.what: Box Canyon from the grass beside the sand track, a held camera looking down it to the blue base under the far wall
views.take: flat tones with crisp edges; the wall's shadow a violet, not a grey; the ground reads as painted, not tiled

views.name: The canyon from above
views.what: Box Canyon from 50 m over its floor: the walls in strata, their shadow across the grass, the base and the fighters small
views.take: the whole map readable at a glance; every cliff outlined; fighters findable

views.name: The sky over the canyon
views.what: the sun, the flat clouds and the cliff's rim from the canyon floor, looking up toward the sun
views.take: a summer sky: cobalt overhead, clouds in two flat colours, the sun blooming

views.name: Dogfight from the chase camera
views.what: an AI pilot's ship over Skyways from its own chase camera, with the HUD
views.take: the ship read by its outline and three tones; engines and shots the brightest things
